newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy allows prisoners to keep pets.
newsitem.headline: Italy allows prisoners to keep pets.

text.p: Italian prisoners are to be allowed to keep pets in their cells.
Cats, fish and caged birds are examples of the small pets they can have to help alleviate boredom and loneliness, Justice Ministry officials said on Wednesday.
Greens Party Senator Athos de Luca said he had proposed the pets programme as a way "to help humanise penal institutions".
Fulco Pratesi, president of Italy's chapter of the World Wildlife Fund, said: "Inmates have a great need for contact with nature and this contact helps speed their social recovery."
